newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel, GEC talk on wider alliance.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel, GEC talk on wider alliance.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom chairman Serge Tchuruk said on Tuesday the company was in talks with alliance partner GEC Co Plc of Britain about cooperation on a larger scale than their current joint venture GEC Alsthom.

Tchuruk told a 1996 results news conference that some difficulaties in GEC Alsthom's plan to buy the French state's stake in nuclear engineering group Framatome had led the two partners to review their alliance.
"Discussions are under way with GEC about GEC Alsthom, concerning a larger area of cooperation than Framatome," he said.
GEC Alsthom is a joint venture in high-speed trains and power generation. The venture wants to buy Framatome to become a leader in nuclear engineering as well.
Tchuruk said the current talks were looking even further than these activities.
"We will make a statement in due time," Tchuruk said, declining to elaborate.
